# Referencias

- Akash Nagaraj, *ASL Alphabet* (Kaggle, `grassknoted/asl-alphabet`).
- Dan Rasband, *ASL Alphabet Test* (Kaggle, `danrasband/asl-alphabet-test`).
- A. Howard et al., "Searching for MobileNetV3", ICCV 2019.
- P. Micikevicius et al., "Mixed Precision Training", ICLR 2018.
- NVIDIA, *CUDA C++ Programming Guide* y *CUDA C++ Best Practices Guide*.
- Numba, *CUDA Kernels* (documentación de `numba-cuda`).
- A. H. Karp y H. P. Flatt, "Measuring Parallel Processor Performance", *Communications of the ACM* 33(5), 1990.
